Prashant Kishor on Brahmin Muslim: jat-pat aur dharm ke chakkar men prashant kishor?| Bhabhi Ji Maidan Me | Bihar Politics | Public Opinion | Ground Report
Bihar men badlav ki rajniti ka danbh bharne vale prashant kishor ab jatiyon ka ganit sadhne men lag gae hain...pike ne darbhanga men ek sammelan ke dauran kaha ki brahmanon ko musalmanon ke sath aa jana chahie...ab saval hai ki khud ko jat-pat se oopar batane vale pike kya brahman -muslim ka gathjor banana chahte hain...
